name: Ivory Coast Djembe
description: _Ivory Coast Djembe. Iroko wood. 13" / 330mm._\\n\\nHard wood full sized djembe with beautiful warm tones. This wood is slightly more porous than other hard woods and this helps absorb some of the 'ringy' high frequencies, giving strong tones and a big warm bass. The shells are wider and therefore have a very comfortable large playing edge. **\\n**
